title: NIST AI RMF MAP 5.1 — Impacts to individuals, groups, and communities are identified and documented
description: The impact-identification control within the MAP function of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary NIST publication — hence 'Community' confidence.
framework_name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
control_text: The likelihood and magnitude of each identified impact — beneficial and harmful — to individuals, groups, communities, and society are identified and documented, drawing on expected use, prior incidents, and external feedback.

citations.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
citations.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires a documented fairness metrics report identifying disparate impacts.
